text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired PDINC-2029 for service=inference-edge-eu severity=critical. Symptoms: 5xx spike, request queueing. Trigger: latency_threshold_eu > 2000ms.

Anika S.: taking PDINC-2029 — oncall here. starting quick triage, assigning temporary ownership.

Marco: acked earlier PDINC-2028 (embeddings-queue-us) but i'm seeing correlation in metrics — EU and US both up on 5xx around the same time. tagging @Priya for routing checks.

Priya: looking. edge-proxy logs show elevated 503s from upstream runtime nodes in eu-west-1. suspecting autoscaler oscillation + cold-start failures. pulling autoscaler events.

pagerduty-bot: PDINC-2029 acknowledged by Anika S. Escalation halted.

Anika S.: quick customer impact note: internal alert says ~3% of hosted API requests in eu region failing with 5xx; some enterprise customers on dedicated plans reporting timeouts. Not a total outage but high error rate.

Marco: checking rollout dashboard — no active canaries. Dedicated pools look healthy but we have lots of transient OOM logs from runtime-34, runtime-37 in the last 3m.

Priya: found relevant logs: ``ERROR: kv-cache-mgr: failed to allocate cache for shard 12: cuda OOM`` repeated -> causing runtime worker restarts. suspect model-variant quantization profile mismatch after a background model swap.

Anika S.: good catch. Can we pin the model back to previous variant or revert recent model swap for EU? If runtime restarts are the culprit, a fast rollback reduces churn.

Priya: i can push a routing override to pin requests to model v1.12 (previous) for eu region. Doing a staged override for 1 minute to verify.

Anika S.: Marco, please open a temporary capacity bump (hot spare pool) for eu inference dedicated nodes to soak load while we stabilize. Set scale to +3 for next 10 minutes.

Marco: done: created scaling action `hot_spare_eu_+3` (id: act-447). Should be provisioning in ~90s. Watching for CPU/GPU attach errors.

pagerbot: Note: simultaneous page PDINC-2028 and PDINC-2029 were detected. Remind: avoid dual-ownership — coordinate handoffs.

Anika S.: i'll own PDINC-2029. @Marco if PDINC-2028 still needs attention please coordinate with @Priya for shared mitigation steps.

Priya: routing override applied: pin eu -> model v1.12. Observability: error rate dropping from 3.2% -> 1.1% in 40s. KV-cache OOM logs reduced.

Marco: hot spare pool provisioned and attached. No GPU attach failures. Request latency improving.

Anika S.: status update to PD channel and SRE lead: mitigation in progress, rollback routing applied, capacity bumped, error rate decreasing. Customer impact: degraded for some EU customers, no data loss, retries recommended client-side.

oncall-sre: quick checklist: 1) keep routing override in place 2) let autoscaler stabilize 3) if error rate >1% after 5m -> escalate to runtime infra for urgent patch 4) prepare postmortem stub.

Priya: agree. i'll monitor logs for 10m. also adding a short-lived datadog alert to notify if OOM returns.

Marco: one more note — i see an unrelated alert flood from embedder-async-queue; suppressing duplicate alerts to reduce noise (muted rules for 5m).

Anika S.: thanks team. i'll update the customer-facing incident slack with a short blurb and estimated ETA 20m for full recovery, pending autoscaler warmup. tagging support to prepare comms. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PDINC-2029 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. If needed, escalate to infra-leads after 12 minutes.

Priya: error rate is now ~0.3% and holding. no further OOMs in recent logs.

Anika S.: ok marking this thread as active mitigation -> we will transition to follow-up postmortem once stable. last check-in from me in 10m unless things regress.

Marco: thanks. saving logs/snippets: ```runtime-37 stderr: ERROR kv-cache-mgr OOM shard 12 at 2026-03-14T15:22:18Z``` — attached to PDINC-2029.

oncall-sre: copy. preparing timeline notes. closing noisy alerts.

Anika S.: closing oncall handoff note: i'll hand back to rotation at 16:00Z if stable. end of thread for now. :white_check_mark:
